sentences.en: Make solidarity and equal rights the cornerstone of public policy.
sentences.zh: 将团结和平等权利作为公共政策的基础。

sentences.en: Algerian Arabs are in solidarity only with Palestinian Arab Muslims.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚阿拉伯人只与巴勒斯坦阿拉伯穆斯林团结一致。

sentences.en: It's important to be in solidarity with one another.

senses.zh: 团结，同心同德；统一，一致
